,b.productName ,b.productSeq

SELECT a.userSeq ,a.userName ,a.userUseNy ,a.userOrder ,a.userDesc ,a.userDelNy ,a.regDateTime ,a.modDateTime ,a.userGender ,a.userId ,a.userPw ,a.userEmail FROM user a WHERE 1=1 AND a.userSeq = #{userSeq}
SELECT a.userId ,a.userPw FROM user a WHERE a.userId = #{userId} AND a.userPw = #{userPw}
